review.reviewer: Claude, maintainer-authorized source and dependency review (AF-CTR-02 delegated author); PR review is recorded separately
review.rationale: AF-CTR-02 part B adds the PostgreSQL store to the Go center: embedded, checksummed SQL migrations applied by arcforges-center migrate under an advisory lock, the platform tables and their access (command receipts, inbox, outbox publisher, job leases with fences, the audit hash chain, signing-key metadata), the least-privilege runtime role with credential rotation and the acceptance database, and the store's readiness and metrics. After two review rounds: a rotation never touches the live slot (the promotion record, confirmed only after a successful deployment, and the live Worker version's slot label read from Cloudflare), migrate revokes PUBLIC's CONNECT and TEMPORARY on the center's database, a failed migration never quotes a value, a stale outbox claimant cannot dead-letter a re-claimed row, Claim dead-letters a job after its maximum attempts, the runtime password (on Neon, which does not support hashed passwords) or its SCRAM-SHA-256 verifier (self-hosted) reaches the server only by binary COPY into a temporary table that a temporary function reads, never in statement text, parameters or errors, and every run records the server version and logging settings. The Container passes the rotated runtime URL to the center (worker/foundation/cloud-container.ts) and the Hello reads through the runtime role. It uses the already admitted pgx v5.11.0 modules and the standard library; no Go, npm or NuGet dependency, base image, toolchain, licence or legal file changes, and the runtime modules shipped in the image are unchanged. The C# Native AOT executable stays the image default for the Hello rollback and the retained D1 gate.
